questions.q: VA home loan denial rate in 2025 HMDA, exact denominator

figures_quoted.rate: 6.61% = 30,421 / 460,346 — scarpero.com CSV, denominator actions 1-5 (acted on), presented as 'the VA denial rate'
figures_quoted.ours_for_comparison: decisioned (actions 1-3, reverse excluded): 115,026 / 712,121 = 16.15%; denied share of the 977,621 applications acted on: 11.8%

questions.verdict: Not ours and not any published decisioned rate; scarpero's VA universe (460,346 acted on) is about half the full loan_type-3 file (977,621), unexplained, as with its FHA row. The engine labelled an acted-on share a 'denial rate'. Inside Mortgage Finance's VA figure (16.1%) matches our decisioned rate. Baseline before our VA receipts exist.

questions.q: HUD August 2026 FHA endorsements and purchase share, with edition

figures_quoted.edition: FHA Single Family Production Report, August 2026 Credit Risk Report, HUD/FHA September 2026 — correct; HECM exclusion noted

sources: hud.gov FHA Production Report landing page
questions.verdict: Exact. The engine read the PDF itself and carried period, edition and exclusion. This refutes the idea that engines cannot restate this report correctly when asked for one edition directly; what a Level-2 receipt adds is the hash-bound edition, the revision check and the contract (what the figure is not), not the number itself. Baseline before our receipts exist.

summary: Baseline for the VA and HUD families before publication: VA answered from the scarpero CSV on an acted-on base (6.61%); HUD answered exactly from the PDF. Useful discovery: the HUD landing page https://www.hud.gov/hud-partners/fha-production-report lists the current edition (for the fetcher).
answer_text:
What was the VA home loan denial rate in the 2025 HMDA data, and what is the exact denominator? Cite the source.
How many FHA single-family loans did HUD endorse in August 2026, and what share were purchase loans? Cite the source and the report edition.

For the **2025 HMDA data**, the VA home-loan denial rate was **6.61%** (30,421 denials out of **460,346** applications in the denominator). For **August 2026**, FHA endorsed **78,925** single-family loans, of which **73.8%** were purchase loans.[1][2]

## VA denial rate

| Measure | Value |
|---|---:|
| VA denial rate | 6.61% (reported as 0.0661) [1] |
| Denials | 30,421 [1] |
| Exact denominator | 460,346 applications [1] |
| Calculation | 30,421 / 460,346 = 6.609% [1] |

The denominator is the HMDA field labeled **`applications_actions_1_5`**: applications that received action codes 1–5—originated, approved but not accepted, denied, withdrawn, or closed as incomplete. It therefore **excludes** purchased loans and preapproval requests that were denied or approved-but-not-accepted.[1]

The underlying 2025 HMDA Loan Application Register data are published by the CFPB/FFIEC; the figures above are the VA loan-type aggregation from the 2025 national denial-rate dataset.[1][3][4]

## FHA August 2026 endorsements

| Measure | Value |
|---|---:|
| FHA single-family endorsements, August 2026 | 78,925 [2] |
| Purchase share | 73.8% [2] |
| Implied purchase endorsements | About 58,247 loans (78,925 × 0.738) [2] |
| Report edition | *FHA Single Family Production Report, August 2026 Credit Risk Report*, sourced to HUD/FHA, September 2026 [2] |

This is the **single-family forward** endorsement count; the report notes that it excludes Home Equity Conversion Mortgages (HECMs).  The companion *FHA Single Family Origination Trends, August 2026* report likewise identifies its July–September figures as covering July and August only, consistent with the August report edition.[2][5]

## Sources

- CFPB announcement of the 2025 HMDA data release:[3]
- FFIEC 2025 HMDA Snapshot National Loan-Level Dataset:[4]
- 2025 national VA denial-rate aggregation and denominator:[1]
- HUD *FHA Single Family Production Report, August 2026 Credit Risk Report*:[2]
- HUD FHA Production Report landing page, listing August 2026 as the current report:[6]
